purpose: Verify the refactor premise: the same onMove->engineMove->checkEnd loop is triplicated across Play/Sparring/Comeback, and the reuse hooks named in the architecture spec exist as described.
verdict: PREMISE CONFIRMED — proceed. Triplication is real and measurable; reuse hooks exist; no controller module exists yet.

components_with_duplicated_loop.role: STRONG copy (clock + pickHumanMove + retryEngineMove + coached takeback + 960 + opening steering + persistence)
WEAK copy (no clock, pickMove only, no retry, no persistence; seeds from Scenario.fen)
WEAK copy (no clock, pickMove only, no retry, no persistence; seeds from ComebackPosition.fen)

src/game/playSession.ts.contents: PURE helpers only (botMovetime, flagOutcome, applyGameResult, BUDGET_BOUNDS). NO controller / NO loop. Confirms audit-v2 W12 intent: this is the 'pure home' but the stateful loop still lives in the 3 components.
src/game/playSession.ts.implication: F6 EXTENDS playSession.ts (or a sibling module) with the stateful loop; the existing pure helpers are consumed unchanged.

src/engine/AdaptiveOpponent.ts.note: pickHumanMove uses Math.random() internally (humanMove sampling) — NOT pure; must stay behind the EngineClient boundary, the controller calls it but the controller core can stay injection-based.

src/engine/EngineClient.ts.note: interrupt() backs Play.retryEngineMove (drop stuck search). Available to siblings if retry is adopted later.

src/game/ChessGame.ts.note: Mutated in place; Svelte 5 does not deep-proxy it — root cause of ADR-0050/0051 reactivity rule the controller must respect (reassign fen each move).

Play.retryEngineMove.note: Play-only capability; absent in Sparring/Comeback. Opt-in flag in the controller, adoption DEFERRED.

Play.coachEvalBad/coachTakeBack/coachKee.note: Play-only coached-takeback; non-blocking. Out of scope for the shared loop core (view concern + Play-specific); keep in Play.

c3_enabler_starting_fen.requirement: Controller must accept a starting FEN so Coach/Sparring can seed designed positions (C3).
evidence: src/analysis/scenarios.ts Scenario.fen + sideToTrain (Sparring already seeds new ChessGame(s.fen))
src/analysis/comeback.ts ComebackPosition.fen + playerColor (Comeback already seeds new ChessGame(positions[i].fen))
Play seeds standard START_FEN or chess960Position(...).startFen
c3_enabler_starting_fen.conclusion: A startFen parameter is a natural, zero-friction part of the controller's init contract; no producer changes needed.

no_existing_controller.note: No GameSessionController / session state machine exists. This is a genuine extraction, not a rewrite of an existing abstraction.
